name: syna-v0.5-workspace

scripts.clean: find packages apps -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find packages apps -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && npm run type-tests
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/pg-test-cluster.mjs with -- node --test apps/hyla-mini/tests/postgres.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/matrix.test.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run demo:minimal && npm run demo:hyla && npm run demo:fluida && npm run demo:features
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:app && npm run demo
scripts.benchmark:v05: npm run build && node --expose-gc benchmarks/v0.5-planning.mjs benchmarks/results-v0.5.0.json

description: Syna v0.5 core, demos and the Hyla-mini application
